# Philippines

Everything this library holds for Philippines, with provenance. Tilt = OLS slope of ln(rate) on wealth rank 0–1; ogcore consumes tilt ÷ 100 (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).

## Adult-mortality route for calibration

No census household-deaths module exists, so use the [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md): at GNI per capita ≈ $4,450 (~2024), predicted tilt(45q15) = **−0.76** ± 0.16, spread across age bands with the by-age offsets in `data/general_gradient.csv`.
